title: AR60034: New Town Planning
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

New Towns: definition and distinction;
Dependent settlements, new communities, accelerated growth centers, planned
area developments, new town in town.
Economic base and socio-economic policies for new town. Site selection:
planning process, criteria and methods.
Thoughts and concepts of new town planning; spatial planning and design
guidelines;
Policies in the context of National and State urbanization policies.
New town planning theory, techniques, models, etc.
Planning norms, standards, infrastructure requirements for new town with case
studies;
Project appraisal, evaluation and monitoring.
Best practices of new town planning and urban design guidelines.
Financing and management of new towns;
Achievement and performance of new towns.
